mapper.select: WITH claimed AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT e.event_id FROM outbox_event e WHERE e.published_at IS NULL AND e.next_attempt_at <= now() AND (e.lease_until IS NULL OR e.lease_until <= now()) ORDER BY e.occurred_at, e.event_id LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE outbox_event o SET lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), attempt_count = o.attempt_count + 1 FROM claimed WHERE o.event_id = claimed.event_id RETURNING o.event_id, o.tenant_id, o.hotel_id, o.aggregate_type, o.aggregate_id, o.aggregate_version, o.event_ordinal, o.event_type, o.schema_version, o.payload::text AS payload, o.occurred_at, o.attempt_count, o.lease_token
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET published_at = now(), lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND published_at IS NULL

UPDATE outbox_event SET lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = #{error}, next_attempt_at = now() + make_interval(secs => #{backoffSeconds}) WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND published_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM outbox_event WHERE published_at IS NULL
SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM now() - min(occurred_at)))::bigint FROM outbox_event WHERE published_at IS NULL
